questions.passage: No respectable boss would say, \"I make it a point to discourage my staff from speaking up, and I maintain a culture that prevents disagreeing viewpoints from ever getting aired.\" If anything, most bosses even say that they are pro-dissent. This idea can be found throughout the series of conversations with corporate, university, and nonprofit leaders, published weekly in the business sections of newspapers. In the interviews, the featured leaders are asked about their management techniques, and regularly claim to continually encourage _______________ from more junior staffers. As Bot Pittman remarked in one of these conversations: \"I want us to listen to these dissenters because they may intend to tell you why we can\'t do something, but if you listen hard, what they\'re really telling you is what you must do to get something done.\"
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
